source._note: Layout-map trace, translated 2026-07-27 to OSM street anchors (Buckley Rd lon -104.7909, E 88th Ave lat 39.85640). Position is FITTED to those anchors, not surveyed and not traced from the aerial scar - see source/SOURCING.md.

route._orientation_doc: Research 2026-07-20: Second Creek ran CLOCKWISE as the primary direction (SCCA-CDR kept separate CW/CCW record books; CW records to 1985, CW is faster). Our ring was CCW -> reverse. S/F on the Buckley Straight (the old Denver Dragway strip, west edge, cars heading NORTH into the Oval Turn), ~39.8595,-104.7896. Pit Road ~280 m on the WEST side of the straight (driver's left), entry mid-straight, exit at the Oval Turn. A CCW layout (2001-2005 era) is a future variant.
